## About

We bring technology, design and business thinking together to help organizations improve the way they operate, communicate and grow — with a focus on practical outcomes and dependable delivery.

Purpose: Make technology useful. Make business simpler. Make growth possible.

Contact: info@brightsoftwaresolution.in · +91 99131 74798 · 808, A Wing, Sonorous, Vapi, Gujarat, India

## How we work

1. Discover — understand your business, objectives, users, workflows and current challenges.
2. Define — agree on scope, priorities, deliverables and a practical plan of action.
3. Design & plan — shape the solution, experience and delivery approach before execution.
4. Build & implement — develop, customize, configure or create the agreed solution.
5. Review & refine — validate the work, gather feedback and make considered improvements.
6. Support & evolve — provide ongoing assistance and help the solution adapt as needs change.

## WhatsApp Business API Platform

URL: https://brightsoftwaresolution.in/whatsapp-business-api/

Connect your own number to the official WhatsApp Cloud API by Meta and manage customer conversations, marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Flows, automation and chatbots from one dashboard.

### What is the WhatsApp Business API?

The WhatsApp Business API — delivered by Meta as the WhatsApp Cloud API — is how growing businesses use WhatsApp at scale. Unlike the free WhatsApp Business app, it supports multiple agents, automated replies, chatbots, integrations and template-based campaigns to customers who have opted in.

Meta provides the API, not a user interface. Bright Software Solution’s platform adds everything your team needs on top of it: a shared inbox, campaign manager, WhatsApp Flows and chatbot builders, automation rules and integrations — so you can go live without writing code.

### Everything you need to grow on WhatsApp

- **Connect your own number** — Self-serve onboarding with Meta’s embedded signup. Your number, your WhatsApp Business Account, your data.
- **Shared team inbox** — Chat with customers in real time. Assign conversations, add internal notes and keep every reply on track.
- **Broadcast campaigns** — Send approved template messages to opted-in audiences and track delivery, reads and replies.
- **WhatsApp Flows** — Collect bookings, leads, orders and feedback with interactive multi-screen forms — right inside the chat.
- **Automation** — Trigger replies, follow-ups and workflows from keywords, events and customer actions.
- **Chatbot builder** — Build no-code chatbots that answer questions, qualify leads and hand over to an agent when needed.
- **Template management** — Create message templates, submit them for Meta approval and reuse them across campaigns and automations.
- **Contacts & segments** — Import contacts, tag them and build segments for targeted, opt-in campaigns.
- **API & integrations** — Connect your ERP, CRM, e-commerce store or website through APIs and webhooks.

### WhatsApp Business app vs. WhatsApp Business API platform

| Capability | WhatsApp Business app | Bright WhatsApp API platform |
|---|---|---|
| Multiple agents | Limited linked devices | Shared team inbox with assignment |
| Bulk messaging | Broadcast lists, delivered only to contacts who saved your number | Template campaigns to opted-in customers at scale |
| Automation & chatbots | Greeting, away messages and quick replies | Chatbot builder, keyword and event automation |
| WhatsApp Flows (in-chat forms) | Not available | Available |
| Integrations | Not available | ERP, CRM, e-commerce via API and webhooks |
| Campaign reporting | Basic | Delivery, read and reply tracking |

### Live on WhatsApp in three steps

1. **Create your account** — Sign up on the platform and set up your workspace and team.
2. **Connect with Meta** — Log in through Meta’s secure signup, choose or create your Meta Business portfolio and verify your phone number.
3. **Chat, campaign, automate** — Import contacts, get templates approved and launch your first campaign, flow or chatbot.

### Why businesses choose Bright for WhatsApp

- **Your number, your account** — Your WhatsApp Business Account and phone number stay in your own Meta Business portfolio.
- **Built by a software & ERP team** — 10+ years of software and ERP experience means we can connect WhatsApp to the systems you already run.
- **Help beyond the software** — Template writing, campaign creatives and onboarding support from the same team that builds brands and runs digital marketing.
- **Guidance through Meta’s requirements** — Business verification, display names, messaging limits and template policies — explained in plain language.

### Popular use cases by industry

- **Retail & e-commerce** — Order confirmations, delivery updates, cart reminders and offers.
- **Manufacturing & distribution** — Dealer orders, dispatch updates, payment reminders and catalogues.
- **Healthcare & clinics** — Appointment booking, reminders and reports-ready alerts.
- **Education** — Admission enquiries, fee reminders and parent communication.
- **Real estate** — Lead capture, site-visit booking and project updates.
- **Services & finance** — Payment reminders, document collection and support.

### FAQ

**Q: What is the difference between the WhatsApp Business app and the WhatsApp Business API?**

A: The WhatsApp Business app is designed for small businesses replying manually from a phone. The WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API) is built for scale: multiple agents, automation, chatbots, integrations and template campaigns to opted-in customers. The API has no interface of its own — our platform provides it.

**Q: Can I use my existing WhatsApp number?**

A: Yes. You connect your own number to your own WhatsApp Business Account through Meta’s signup. If the number is already active on WhatsApp, we guide you through Meta’s options to connect or migrate it.

**Q: Do I need a Meta Business account?**

A: Yes. During onboarding you log in with Facebook and create or select a Meta Business portfolio. Business verification is recommended to unlock higher messaging limits, and we guide you through it.

**Q: How much does the WhatsApp Business API cost?**

A: There are two parts: Meta’s messaging charges, which depend on the message category (marketing, utility or authentication) and the recipient’s country, and the platform subscription. Under Meta’s current pricing, replies inside the 24-hour customer service window are free. Contact us for a plan that fits your volume.

**Q: Can I send bulk WhatsApp messages?**

A: Yes — to customers who have opted in, using message templates approved by Meta. Your sending limits grow as your number maintains a good quality rating.

**Q: What are WhatsApp Flows?**

A: WhatsApp Flows are interactive, multi-screen forms that open inside a chat. They are ideal for booking appointments, capturing leads, collecting feedback or taking orders without sending customers to a website.

**Q: Can the chatbot hand over to a human agent?**

A: Yes. Chatbots can answer common questions and qualify leads, then route the conversation to the right agent in the shared team inbox.

**Q: Can you integrate WhatsApp with our ERP or CRM?**

A: Yes. Integration is one of our core strengths — we connect the platform with ERP, CRM, e-commerce and custom applications using APIs and webhooks.

- **System integrations** — Connect applications, ERP, payment gateways, WhatsApp and third-party services through APIs.
- **Enhancements & modernization** — Extend, improve and stabilize applications you already depend on.

### Our delivery focus

- **Fit for purpose** — Designed around the needs of the business and the people who use it every day.
- **Connected operations** — Systems built to work with your existing tools, data and teams.

### What you can build with us

### FAQ

**Q: How long does a software project take?**

A: Smaller tools can go live in weeks, while larger platforms are delivered in phases so you see value early. We agree milestones during the Define stage of our process.

**Q: Can you improve an application we already have?**

A: Yes. We regularly enhance, extend and stabilize existing applications, including adding integrations and new modules.

**Q: Can the software integrate with our ERP or WhatsApp?**

A: Yes. System integration is a core capability — we connect custom software with ERP systems, payment gateways, our WhatsApp Business API platform and other services.

URL: https://brightsoftwaresolution.in/erp-implementation-customization/

We help businesses configure, adapt and extend ERP systems — from process mapping and implementation support to custom modules, integrations, user enablement and ongoing improvements.

### An ERP that works the way your business does

An ERP only delivers value when it reflects real processes. We help businesses configure and adapt ERP systems so that sales, purchasing, inventory, production, finance and people work from the same reliable information.

Every engagement starts with understanding your workflows and operational priorities. From there we plan the implementation, customize modules and workflows, connect the ERP with other systems and make sure your team is confident using it.

### Our ERP services

- **Process mapping** — Document how work really flows today and design how it should flow in the ERP.
- **Implementation support** — Configuration, setup and go-live support with a practical, phased plan.
- **Module & workflow customization** — Adapt modules, forms, approvals and reports to your business rules.
- **Integrations** — Connect the ERP with e-commerce, portals, WhatsApp, payment and other business systems.
- **Data & operational readiness** — Plan master data, migration and operational cut-over so teams start with clean information.
- **User enablement** — Role-based guidance so every team member can work confidently in the system.

### Why businesses trust us with their ERP

- **Business-first thinking** — We start with the business need and select the approach that serves it.
- **Practical, tailored solutions** — Every organization has different processes, priorities and constraints.
- **Collaborative delivery** — Clear communication, regular feedback and shared expectations at every stage.
- **A long-term mindset** — Ongoing support and continuous improvement long after go-live.

### Business areas we support

- **Sales & CRM** — Quotations, orders, customers and pipelines.
- **Purchase & vendors** — Requisitions, purchase orders and vendor management.
- **Inventory & warehouse** — Stock, transfers, batches and warehouse operations.

- **Reporting & dashboards** — Management reports and KPIs across departments.

### FAQ

## General FAQ

**Q: Can I use my own WhatsApp number?**

A: Yes. You connect your own number to your own WhatsApp Business Account through Meta's signup. If the number is already active on WhatsApp, we guide you through Meta's requirements to connect or migrate it.

**Q: Do my customers need to install anything?**

A: No. Customers chat with you in the WhatsApp app they already use — campaigns, flows and chatbot replies all arrive as normal WhatsApp messages.

**Q: What kind of businesses do you work with?**

A: We work with growing and established organizations in India and across international markets — anywhere technology, design or digital presence can help a business operate better and grow.

**Q: Can you customize the ERP we already use?**

A: Yes. Beyond new implementations, we help adapt existing ERP systems — module and workflow customization, process mapping, integrations, user enablement and ongoing improvements.

**Q: Do you build both web and mobile applications?**

A: We do — web applications, mobile solutions, business portals, workflow tools and integrations, as well as enhancements to applications you already run.

**Q: Can one team handle our software, brand and marketing together?**

A: That's exactly where we add value. Coordinating technology, design, digital marketing and infrastructure through one partner keeps everything consistent and saves you from managing multiple vendors.

**Q: What happens after launch?**

A: Support and evolution are part of our process. We provide ongoing assistance, monitoring and maintenance, and help your solution adapt as your needs change.
